cumulative_metrics.diagnostic_scope: Time-weighted 50Hz control endpoints; nonfoot events use each control's maximum 400Hz body/coxa/femur floor force >1N. These are reporting metrics, not Stage2 admission.

termination_reasons.scope: Counts returned terminal rows with each measured predicate; reasons may overlap. Timeout counts returned truncations separately.
